ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_pairwise_advantage_gap_softmax_weighted_ranking
ir.intuition: Shift paradigm_family to 'pairwise_ranking', use an importance weighting derived from a softmax of advantage_gap to prioritize harder pairs, apply a sigmoid link for smooth preference modeling, and aggregate by weighted mean. This differs from margin-based or direct log-prob margin losses by learning a smooth ranking loss emphasizing pairs with larger advantage disparity.
ir.pseudocode:
weights = softmax(advantage_gap)
loss_i = -sigmoid(log_prob_w - log_prob_l)
weighted_loss = loss_i * weights * weight
loss = sum(weighted_loss) / sum(weights * weight)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch["log_prob_w"]
    lpl = batch["log_prob_l"]
    weight = batch.get("weight", ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv_gap = batch["advantage_gap"]

    # Compute importance weights via softmax over advantage_gap
    imp_weights = ops.exp(adv_gap)
    imp_weights_sum = ops.sum(ops.mul(imp_weights, weight))
    normalized_weights = ops.div(ops.mul(imp_weights, weight), imp_weights_sum)

    # Compute pairwise score difference and sigmoid link
    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    losses = ops.neg(ops.sigmoid(diff))

    weighted_losses = ops.mul(losses, normalized_weights)
    loss = ops.sum(weighted_losses)
    return loss
